dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave spline curvature transitioning from a linear dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute apex with a minimal pixel radius defined by a single vertex meeting two straight edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 52-degree incline relative to the longitudinal horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of maximum pixel base width to vertical height is approximately 1.25:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a wide radius defined by low-resolution polygonal segments along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak with a pixel length approximately 0.5 times the vertical thickness of the head at the eye coordinate.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope transitions to the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan luminescent texture and low-poly faceted mesh geometry throughout the subject.
